[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Overnight Oats**: Mix rolled oats, plant-based milk, and choice of nuts, seeds, or fruit in a jar. Refrigerate overnight.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Avocado Toast**: Toast whole grain bread, mash avocado, add lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Optional: fried or poached tofu egg or nutritional yeast.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Chia Seed Pudding**: Mix chia seeds with plant-based milk, refrigerate overnight, top with fresh fruit and nuts.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Vegan Smoothie Bowl**: Blend fruits, veggies, and plant-based milk, top with granola, nuts, and fresh fruit.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Tofu Scramble**: Scramble tofu with turmeric, nutritional yeast, and spices. Serve with whole grain toast or wrap.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Quinoa Breakfast Bowl**: Cook quinoa, mix with plant-based milk, nuts, and fresh fruit, drizzle with maple syrup.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Green Smoothie**: Blend spinach, banana, plant-based milk, and lemon juice. Optional: protein powder.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Vegan Pancakes**: Use almond flour and plant-based milk, top with fresh fruit, maple syrup, or coconut whipped cream.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Breakfast Burrito**: Scramble tofu, add black beans, salsa, and avocado, wrap in whole grain tortilla.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Muesli**: Mix rolled oats, nuts, seeds, and dried fruit, add plant-based milk.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Cinnamon Rolls**: Make vegan cinnamon rolls with almond flour and plant-based milk.
